## What changes for a visitor or contributor?

Explain the concrete problem and final behavior. Link a related issue if present.

## Evidence and data

For factual changes: source URL, publication date, page/table, units, location
precision and reuse terms. For code-only changes, write “No data change”.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include desktop/mobile
screenshots for visible changes. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Review notes

Mention remaining limitations or tradeoffs that affect this change.
